spec.description: An account's posts and reposts, newest first, paged by cursor.

request.title: GetAuthorFeedRequest
request.description: Whose feed, which posts, which page.

actor.description: Handle or DID of the account, such as `bsky.app` or `did:plc:z72i7hdynmk6r22z27h6tvur`.

limit.description: Rows per page. Range [1, 100]; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque page token from the previous response; omit for the first page.
Token for the next page; absent on the last one.

unverified.detail: No recording yet: the sandbox this spec was written in cannot reach bsky.app. The `record.yml` workflow replays `examples/*.request.json` through the generated client with `truewire capture` and opens a pull request with the responses.

notes: Written from the `app.bsky`/`com.atproto` lexicons as remembered, not read: the docs host was unreachable. The schema is a subset of the lexicon; undeclared fields pass validation and are dropped from the validated value. The first recording confirms or corrects it.
`filter` lists the four values the lexicon has carried since the parameter was added; newer additions are not listed because their names were not checked against the docs.
